title: Creamy Almond Bliss Soup
description: A rich and creamy soup made with almond milk and a hint of blissful flavor. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: In a large pot, sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the potato, almond milk, and bliss. Stir well.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve warm, garnished with chopped herbs if desired.
